newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes firmer as call rates up.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes firmer as call rates up.

text.p: An abrupt rise in call money rates helped the Bangladesh taka close firmer at 43.2920/2950 to the dollar in interbank trading on Saturday against the previous close at 43.2920/2980, dealers said.
"Many banks offered dollar at cheaper rates but there was not much response from buyers. Many a bank didn't have enough taka to buy dollars. There were very few deals," said one dealer.

The call money was traded at 9 to 10 percent, up from previous 6.0-6.25 percent, dealers said. Call rates shot up as Thursday's auction of central bank bills worth over two billion taka put some banks in a temporary liquidity crisis.
